_comment: See the header of sift-api/setup.cfg for the doctrine this follows. Mutation testing answers what coverage cannot: do these tests catch bugs, or do they only execute lines? A surviving mutant is a line the tests run but do not check. SCOPE IS DELIBERATELY NARROW and this is NOT wired into CI — run it by hand every month or two (npm run mutate), record the result in a comment at the top of the matching test file, and fix only the survivors that represent real gaps. Pointing it at all of lib/ would burn 30+ minutes on DB and LLM wrappers whose mutants are unkillable because the tests mock the client.
_mutate_comment: Pure, deterministic, high-consequence. security.ts is the CSRF gate; rate-limit.ts is the spend ceiling on /api/compare; utils.ts holds stableHash, the article primary key shared with sift-api's services/rss.py; usage-tracker.ts prices every AI call; crossSpectrum.ts decides what counts as corroboration.
_thresholds_comment: break is null on purpose: a score gate on a manual run produces alarms you learn to ignore. Read the survivors, do not chase the number.
_coverageAnalysis_comment: 'off', not 'perTest'. perTest is much faster but requires replacing jest's testEnvironment with @stryker-mutator/jest-runner's wrapper in jest.config.ts — changing how the suite runs for everyone, in exchange for speed on a tool run by hand every month or two. Not a trade worth making. 'all' hits the same requirement. With 'off' the scoped run below takes ~1 minute.
_baseline_comment: Baseline 2026-08-17, first run: 85.34% overall, 1m18s, 56 survivors. crossSpectrum.ts 100.00 | security.ts 91.30 | usage-tracker.ts 88.14 | utils.ts 78.62 | rate-limit.ts 71.43. The survivors were read, not chased. rate-limit.ts is the lowest and shows both kinds. REAL GAP: `t > cutoff` -> `t >= cutoff` survived the entire suite because no test sat a timestamp exactly on the window boundary — an off-by-one that holds every request one extra millisecond, so a caller pacing itself at the limit collects spurious 429s. Closed by the boundary test in __tests__/rate-limit.test.ts; that is what took the file from 69.05 to 71.43. EQUIVALENT MUTANT, leave it: `if (entry.timestamps.length === 0) store.delete(key)` survives because the cleanup sweep is unobservable through the public API. Update this line on each run so the number cannot drift unnoticed.
